decisions.reason: The same-message candidate MODIFY already captures the FCC/FH and Site 154Q start and end dates. The allocated-budget changes require no additional date update.
The same-message candidate INTRODUCE already records that Site 154Q has the alternate identifier 201. The budget changes require no additional labeling update.

The site-specific allocated budgets do not change the existing rule to calculate wages from actual compensated sessions and make the support sheet total match the applicable budget. The source does not provide new session counts or rates for these sites.
The source changes budgets, service dates, a site identifier, and the stated number of weeks; it does not change the signature requirement or its placement.
